facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna smiled at everyone in town. She said kind words to sad people. They felt better. She helped people feel happy again. Her kindness changed people.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: At first, many people in town thought Pollyanna was too cheerful. But slowly, her warm words and bright smile touched their hearts. The grumpy old man began to laugh. The lonely woman made new friends. One by one, the townspeople changed. Her kindness changed people in ways nobody expected.
facts.Word cards: changed = 변화시켰다 / positivity = 긍정 / contagious = 전염되는 / spread = 퍼졌다
